metadata.name: php
metadata.description: kind "php" — PHP source defining named functions; the trailing line names the callable (use the := php.<fn>{ … } selector). Compiled via php-wasm: each compile defines its source in a fresh PHP namespace so a recompile never "Cannot redeclare". The runtime call is async (returns a Promise — fireCel awaits it), so a php verb works as a whole-formula value. Dynamic-imported on first compile.
Runtime-ready sentinel. Stays true at boot (lazy-load masks the transition).
Append-only log of CelError values produced by php lambdas. v1: empty array.
